intent: Extract only the defined fields using exact source text. Preserve source formatting. Use null for absent or ambiguous scalar values; do not arbitrarily choose among multiple values. For repeated columns preserve each complete source row relation and exact supporting quotes.

fields.description: Name of the advertiser or advertising client on the order; distinguish it from the agency and broadcaster.
Name of the advertising agency placing the order, if separately stated.
Advertising order or contract identifier, preserving the exact source spelling and leading zeros.
Start date of the overall advertising flight or order period.
End date of the overall advertising flight or order period.
Gross amount for the entire advertising order, not a line amount, net amount or commission.
Advertised product or campaign description explicitly named in the order.
Postal address of the television station or broadcaster, not the advertiser or agency address.
Broadcast property or television station name explicitly associated with the advertising order.
Channel or station identifier on each advertising line. Keep it aligned with the other values from that same source line.
Program or advertising spot description on each ordered line, aligned with its own dates and amount.
Start date explicitly associated with each advertising line, not an unrelated overall order date.
End date explicitly associated with each advertising line, not an unrelated overall order date.
Amount charged for each advertising line or program schedule line, not the order total or unit rate.
